title: feat(spec): every step a flow drawing shows can be translated, under flows.FLOW.nodes.NODE_ID.label
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbYV2nRmpjdz5BmCf9psuMXA)_

Part of #35979 (Asked item 2 only, as ruled in comment 7076440876; Asked item 1 is PR #36335)

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTrJZvNaijgX3NxBMc

Clause-②: yes (widening: a new translation key `flows.FLOW.nodes.NODE_ID.label`, and the new exports `FLOW_TECHNICAL_NODE_TYPES` and `isFlowTechnicalNodeType` from `@objectstack/spec/automation`)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：应用包现在可以给流程里每个步骤（开始、判断、通知、结束等）写各语言名称；中文手册里的流程图不再夹英文步骤名。已发布语言的应用在检查里会多出这些步骤的缺译提示。
- 为什么做：HotCRM 销售手册的审批流程图在中文下仍显示英文的判断和通知步骤，维护者在卡上选了「补上翻译位，可以翻译」。
- 出错会怎样：只影响显示和缺译提示，不改流程运行和任何数据；可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Built in two halves on this branch. **This draft currently carries the spec, validation and coverage half; the docs-viewer reader lands here once PR #36335 (item 1, which moves the shared flow-label resolver into `@object-ui/i18n`) is on `main`.** Until then the ledger row for the new key is `planned`.

- **The key** (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`). `flows.FLOW.nodes.NODE_ID.label`, a strict entry with one plain-text leaf, `label`, overlaying the node's own `FlowNode.label`. It addresses every node but a `screen` (whose `screens.NODE_ID.title` covers `config.title ?? node.label`) and an `approval` (`approvals.NODE_ID.label`), so one string keeps one key. `nodes` was an unknown-key alias onto `screens`; it is now the real group (`node` aliases onto it). The `## nodes` docblock section states the rule; the convention list gains the row.
- **Start and end nodes (ruling item 3).** Keyed like any other step; the viewer supplies no words of its own. Measured on `examples/app-showcase` at c448c615: of the start/end labels, 25 are `End` and 11 `Start`, but the rest name an outcome or a trigger (`Approved` x5, `Rejected` x5, `Signed Off`, `Declined`, `On Task Created` x3, `Daily at 06:00`, ...), which a generic word would erase.
- **Validation** (`packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts`). A `nodes` key over an unknown node is `translation-target-unknown` with the nearest node offered; over a `screen` it is pointed at `screens.NODE_ID.title`, over an `approval` at `approvals.NODE_ID.label`. The reverse slips now point at the new key: a `screens` or `approvals` key over any other node says `its label is keyed nodes.NODE_ID.label` (two existing messages gain that clause instead of "so nothing resolves").
- **The demand** (`packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts`, `i18n/missing-flow`). Every top-level node the docs embed draws at its default `detail: business` altitude, minus screens and approvals, which were already demanded. Region-nested nodes are accepted by validation but not demanded: the embed does not draw them. `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts` only updates the bucket's description.
- **One table for business altitude** (`packages/spec/src/automation/flow-altitude.ts`). The viewer's private `TECHNICAL_NODE_TYPES` set becomes `FLOW_TECHNICAL_NODE_TYPES` + `isFlowTechnicalNodeType` in `@objectstack/spec/automation`, so the walk and the viewer agree on which steps a reader sees. The viewer switches to it in the reader half.
- **Examples.** `app-crm`'s lead-conversion wizard gets its three drawn steps in zh-CN (its baseline stays 0). The ratchet in `scripts/i18n-coverage-baseline.json` is raised for the new population, as the PR that first walked the validation-message family did: `app-showcase` 317 -> 424 (+107), `app-todo` 106 -> 128 (+22); the other 12 configs are unchanged (the ten bundle packages stay 0, `check:i18n` in sync).
- **Ledger and pins.** `liveness/translation.json` gains `flows.nodes` (+ `label`) as `planned`, flipped to `live` with the reader. `flows-translation-face.test.ts`: the `node.label` row now lists `nodes.NODE.label` beside `approvals.NODE.label`.
- **Generated.** `api-surface/automation.json`, `export-origins/automation.json`, `content/docs/references/system/translation.mdx`, the strictness-ledger counts and the liveness state counts, regenerated by `check:generated --fix`.

## Read first (by risk)

1. `packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts`, the new loop at the end of `walkScreenFlows`: what is demanded (top level, not technical, not screen/approval).
2. `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`, the `nodes` entry and the `nodes` alias removal.
3. `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts`, the `nodes` block and the two redirect clauses.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/i18n-flow-node-coverage.test.ts`; expect 6 passed, including HotCRM's `opportunity_approval` shape asking for its start, decision, notify, loop and end labels and nothing for its approvals, screen or record write.

## Tests

<details><summary>Pins</summary>

- `packages/cli/test/i18n-flow-node-coverage.test.ts` (new family file, like the screen / approval / refusal family files beside it): the walker harvests exactly the drawn steps with no other key, seeded with the authored label; nothing for any `FLOW_TECHNICAL_NODE_TYPES` type or an id-less node; every harvested key parses and is kept by `TranslationDataSchema`; the coverage gate lists them in the flow bucket and goes quiet once translated.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.test.ts`: a new top-level describe (clean run over start / decision / loop / nested notify / end beside the other groups; `nodes` over an approval and over a screen redirected; unknown node with suggestion), the two changed redirect messages, and the one-line-verdict arm list gains the four new arms.
- The screen, approval and liveness-gate family files in `packages/cli/test/` pin exact key lists of their own family; they now read every key but the `nodes` family (one predicate per file, pointing at the new file).
</details>

<details><summary>Runs (head cafc3fdf unless noted)</summary>

- `@objectstack/lint` whole suite: `Test Files 225 passed (225)`, `Tests 9431 passed (9431)` (at eabf0e62; lint unchanged since).
- `@objectstack/cli` unit project, the 60 i18n / translation / lint test files: 18 failures at eabf0e62, all exact key lists in the three family files above; after the predicate, those 4 files `Tests 52 passed (52)`.
- `@objectstack/spec`: `flows-translation-face.test.ts` + `translation.test.ts`, `Tests 238 passed (238)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: 5 stale before regeneration, all 5 green after `--fix`.
- `node scripts/check-i18n-coverage.mjs`: before the baseline edit `app-crm 0 -> 3`, `app-showcase 317 -> 424`, `app-todo 106 -> 128`; after: `OK (14 config(s), 552 baselined untranslated string(s), none new)`. `pnpm check:i18n`: all ten bundle packages in sync. `pnpm check:i18n-walk-parity`: 17 declared, 15 walked, 2 exempted.
- Derived gate sweep (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 127 commands): running; results added here.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `flows.FLOW.label` is still demanded only for a flow with a screen or an approval node, although item 1's viewer draws the label of every embedded flow. Not widened here, by the seat's word; the seat files it.
- HotCRM's own translations (`opportunity_approval`: 9 of 11 drawn steps) are a follow-up in that repository once this key is on `main`, filed through the seat.
- A screen node that declares a `config.title` shows its node label in the viewer, and that label has no key of its own (its `screens.NODE_ID.title` translates the heading). The reader half reads the title key only for a screen without a `config.title`.
